reviews.comment:
Estación de servicio normal, limpia y con combustible levemente más caro. Si es turista y desea quedarse en la localidad, evite preguntar en este lugar donde alojarse o donde comer: Le indicarán los lugares más costosos y no por ello los mejores. Por caso el restaurante frente a esta YPF la que supuestamente tiene platos regionales (chivitos, etc.) al mejor precio; todo lo contrario, sólo minutas mal elaboradas y a un excesivo valor.

(Translated by Google)
This is a standard, clean gas station with slightly more expensive fuel. If you're a tourist planning to stay in the area, avoid asking for lodging or dining recommendations here: they'll point you to the most expensive places, which aren't necessarily the best. For example, the restaurant across the street from this YPF station, which supposedly offers regional dishes (like chivitos) at the best prices, is actually quite the opposite—it only serves poorly prepared, overpriced snacks.
